description: Participation occurs late and has little influence on decisions.
Co-design informs framing prototypes criteria and revisions.
User insight informs experts but affected groups have limited decision influence.
Community governance and decision traceability are central.
Creative workshops generate energy but do not shape decisions.
Frontline workers help redesign workflows and implementation supports.
Policy options are developed through facilitated stakeholder and community input.
Organizations collect lived experience but return little accountability or influence.
